prompt: In some countries, most people prefer to rent their houses rather than buy their housees. What are the advantages and disadvantages of renting a home?
essay:
The citizens of some nations would rather rent their homes instead of owning them. Although this approach limits tenants' ability to personalise their houses to their liking , alongside carrying a risk of eviction, it enables them to live in a good neighbourhood, and it allows them to adapt their living arrangements more easily to their changing needs.

On the downside, landlords often prohibit any modification to the property . Thus , individuals will not have the freedom to customise their homes according to their personal preferences. Besides that, they will be constantly dealing with the possibility of displacement. As they will be living in someone else's property , the lessor can end the leasing contract for justified or unjustified reasons, such as not paying the agreed rent, an agreement with new tenants , or even selling the property to another owner. For instance , it is common in some Middle Eastern countries for landowners to end the leasing contract with the tenant to re-lease the accommodation to a family member in need of a place.

Nonetheless , renting can be a great alternative in areas where accommodation prices are high or housing is scarce. It allows individuals to live in a desirable location without having to wait until they can afford to purchase a property there. Furthermore , renting provides greater flexibility, allowing people to change their homes as their needs evolve, whereas homeowners have to sell their property and find a suitable buyer before moving. For example , renting allows married couples to easily move to a larger property when they have children, while workers can relocate to accommodation closer to their workplace.

In conclusion, although renting can restrict tenants' freedom to customise their homes and expose them to the risk of eviction, it offers greater flexibility and allows people to live in desirable locations without the financial burden of purchasing a property .
